status: proposal from spike S6 (issue #10); values with 'assumption: true' must be calibrated on real data (M5)
units: W, Wh, kW, kWh, degC, K/kW, kWh/K unless stated in the key name

inverter.family: ZCS 1PH HYD 6000 ZSS HP (Sofar HYD-ES family), single phase, 48 V battery

offGridSelfConsumptionW.note: not in the datasheet (only standby < 10 W); measure in M5

battery.roundTripNote: 0.94 x 0.94, slightly below the 0.946 per-direction maximum of the inverter battery path (conservative)

coldChargeDerate.note: the BMS limits charge current below 15 degC; not relevant for the summer demo

stormDayFactor.note: fraction of the monthly mean on an overcast storm day; replace with the p10 day when the real location is known

hvacUnits.source: Hisense Easy Smart technical sheet 31/01/2025 (cooling at 27/19 degC indoor, 35/24 degC outdoor)
hvacUnits.partLoadModel: input = clamp(thermalDemandKw / eer, coolingInputKw.min, coolingInputKw.max); below min the unit cycles on/off

dryMode.behaviour: compressor at low speed, indoor fan at low/auto speed, compressor stops when room temperature reaches the set point
dryMode.note: no datasheet figure for dry-mode input power; calibrate with ConnectLife daily kWh

fans.coolingEffectNote: CBE: about 2 degC at 0.5 m/s; ASHRAE 55 allows up to 0.8 m/s without occupant control (up to about 4 degC). We use less than the 0.5 m/s value.

powerW.note: fan type and control path still unknown (S8)

thermal.model: 1R1C per room: C dT/dt = (Tout - T)/R + Qhvac + Qinternal + Qsolar

timeConstantH.note: = capacitance / UA; follows from the two ranges above

thermal.derivation: UA = walls (0.7-1.3 W/m2K) + windows (2.5-5 W/m2K) + infiltration (0.3-0.9 ACH); C between the shallow-mass estimate (0.0036-0.0054 kWh/K per m3) and the ISO 13790 medium-heavy mass classes (165-260 kJ/m2K)

solarGainFactor.note: fraction of irradiance on the window area that becomes heat

derivedChecks.note: 3 x 12000 + 2 x 18000 + 1 x 24000, without the 9000 BTU units (count unknown). Grid-tied: above 6 kW the grid supplies the rest. Off-grid (EPS): hard cap 5000 VA and battery 5000 W.
